concerns.text: SC-004 specifies that the correlation between the shift vector and SentEval performance drop must be computed after reducing the shift vector to N components (dimensionality reduction). No task in tasks.md implements this reduction step; existing tasks (T029, T056, T057) compute correlation directly on the full shift vector, leaving the spec requirement unaddressed.

T060 is intended to provide a feasibility gate and generate `data/processed/feasibility_report.json`, but the task description notes it is incomplete: no detailed warning is logged, T012b is never marked “SKIPPED”, and the required output file is missing. This violates FR‑005/SC‑005 and Constitution Principle I.
